subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept this plugin UI entry-point API and launch/session-token security model as the durable Control UI extension path, or defer it to the broader Control UI contribution-slot/native-page direction?
rationale: This is a public plugin and protocol expansion with a new authenticated iframe route boundary, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API or security posture.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Approve the public entry-point contract and require fresh live proof on the current head before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader RFC
options.body: Pause this PR and continue the API shape in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 if maintainers prefer descriptor/native slots over sandboxed route entries.

options.title: Decline core expansion
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers decide plugin UIs should stay outside the Control UI until a different extension seam is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Approve the public entry-point contract and require fresh live proof on the current head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged host-hook foundation and the related RFC issue that frames this plugin UI extension direction.
